title: Migrate Reverse Survivors into the testsAndMisc monorepo
objective: Relocate the standalone React 19 + Vite 8 + TypeScript 6 game from ~/Downloads/reverse/reverse-survivors to reverse_survivors/ inside this monorepo, preserving its toolchain and quality gates verbatim. Success means the project builds, lints, and passes its 100 % coverage gate from the new path; a root-level path-scoped GitHub Actions workflow runs those same gates on every touching push or PR; and the directory is listed in both index tables. The migration is complete only when npm run check passes in place — a moved project that cannot build is the failure mode this contract exists to prevent.
acceptance_criteria: reverse_survivors/ contains all 33 project files; git status --porcelain -uall reports 33 and nothing was swallowed by the root .gitignore
The project's nested .github/ is deleted and its workflow lives at .github/workflows/reverse-survivors-ci.yml with paths: filters and defaults.run.working-directory both naming reverse_survivors
npm ci, npm run check (typecheck + eslint --max-warnings 0 + vitest at 100 % thresholds), and npm run build all pass from reverse_survivors/
npm run dev serves the app and Vite transforms /src/main.tsx from the new path
README.md and CLAUDE.md each gain a reverse_survivors/ Repository Layout row
The commit stages explicit paths only, leaving the concurrent uncommitted billsplit migration and the other modified files in the working tree untouched
out_of_scope: Converting the project from npm to pnpm, or regenerating package-lock.json
Changing the project's source code, pinned dependency versions, ESLint config, or coverage thresholds
Adding a per-project run.sh — meta/run.sh is a polling-script profiler, not a project dispatcher, and Node 24 is already present locally
Committing, fixing, or otherwise touching the in-progress billsplit migration sitting untracked in this working tree
Backfilling the missing billsplit/ and bucket_catch/ rows in the index tables
verifier: cd reverse_survivors && npm ci && npm run check && npm run build (the project's own gate, mirrored by .github/workflows/reverse-survivors-ci.yml), plus pre-commit run --files and pre-commit run --hook-stage pre-push --files over the staged paths
